Two multiplicatively independent rational zero-class elements generate dense radii, and rational norm-one Gaussian points generate dense angles; multiplication by a level witness yields dense fibers. An exact standalone verifier corroborates 5280 Gaussian rational cases and 452 constructive levels, without substituting finite data for the proof.
